note: This file is a MMDetection configuration file containing only variable assignments (dicts, lists, scalars). It has no functions, classes, or callable APIs. It configures a Faster R-CNN (ResNet-50 + FPN) model for Pascal VOC2007 object detection using the DSDLDetDataset format.
config_model: configure a Faster R-CNN model with ResNet-50 FPN backbone and 20 VOC classes
config_dataset: configure a DSDLDetDataset for Pascal VOC2007 with train and test splits
config_pipeline: configure train and test data pipelines with resize, flip, and annotation loading
config_evaluator: configure a VOCMetric evaluator using 11-point mAP for validation
config_training: configure an SGD optimizer with MultiStepLR scheduler over 12 epochs
